about.title: Eastvale Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Eastvale sits along the I-15 corridor, where commuter traffic mixes with local trips down Limonite Avenue, Schleisman Road, and Hamner Avenue. Public records show 185 injury collisions and 248 people hurt in the most recent reporting year, with reports clustering on Wednesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. — a window when work traffic, school pickups, and errands overlap. If you were injured in one of these crashes, the moments right after matter: photos, witness names, and medical records can fade or disappear fast. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we simply connect you, free of charge, with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened and explain your options. There's no obligation, and the attorneys in our network only get paid if you recover compensation. You focus on healing; let someone experienced sort through the claim details.
commonInjuries: Cuts, bruising, and soft tissue damage

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer Calls

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim in California, though claims against a government entity — say, for a road or signal issue — can require notice in as little as six months. Missing that window can end a claim before it starts.

items.title: Comparative Fault Cuts Both Ways
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your share of blame reduces your payout. An attorney can help make sure early statements to an insurer don't overstate your fault before facts are fully sorted.

items.title: No Cap on What You've Truly Lost
items.desc: California doesn't cap non-economic damages like pain and suffering, so full documentation of your injury's impact matters. An attorney working on contingency has an incentive to build that record thoroughly, without upfront cost to you.

items.question: I was in a crash on Hamner Avenue — should I give the other driver's insurer a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's usually wise to hold off. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. Speaking with an independent attorney first, even briefly, can help you understand what you're agreeing to before you say anything on record.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after an Eastvale car accident?
items.answer: California generally gives you two years from the date of the crash, but if a government entity — like a public road agency — may be involved, the window to file a claim can shrink to as little as six months. Because Eastvale's roads include areas maintained by different agencies, it's worth having someone review this early.

items.question: What does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and we don't charge for referrals. Attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if your case results in a recovery.
